senses.gloss: m. pl. (Pers. iskodâr, ἀσκάνδης, σαγγάνδης, ἀστάδης; v. Perles Et. St. p. 113) prop. despatch-bearers, name of a game, a kind of chess.
units: Kidd. 21ᵇ באי׳ אטללתו Ar. (Var. Ar. בסק׳; ed. איסקומדרי) you must have played at iskundré (instead of studying).
<cite ref="Shevuot 29a:10">Shebu. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>דילמא איס׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="A01496"><he>איסקודרי</he></cite>) perhaps he gave them checkers (tokens in game) and passed them for Zuzé.
